description: Figure 4 is a grouped bar chart illustrating the popularity of generated entities (Pop_Ge) and ground-truth entities (Pop_GT) for incorrectly answered samples, alongside Pop_GT (and also Pop_Ge) for correctly answered samples, across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis displays these three categories in order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled "Popularity," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 220, with tick marks at intervals of 20. The chart contains multiple bars per category, distinguished by color and pattern according to a legend: blue solid bars represent Llama3, red solid bars represent Qwen2, and yellow solid bars represent ChatGPT. Additionally, there are patterned bars indicating different accuracy conditions: hatched bars represent "Acc=0 & GT Ans" (incorrect answers with ground-truth answers), cross-hatched bars represent "Acc=0 & Gene Ans" (incorrect answers with generated answers), and white bars represent "Acc=1 & GT Ans" (correct answers with ground-truth answers). For each category, the bars for "Acc=0 & Gene Ans" (incorrect generated answers) are consistently taller than the corresponding "Acc=0 & GT Ans" (incorrect ground-truth answers), and the bars for "Acc=1 & GT Ans" (correct ground-truth answers) are consistently shorter than the "Acc=0 & GT Ans" bars. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in the order of the categories on the horizontal axis.
